title: OutSystems telemetry source config
description: The config of a telemetry source of source_type outsystems (ADR 0017): which OutSystems application's telemetry is an application's own. OutSystems 11 self-managed is ingest_mode agentless, read from the logging database by an outsystems_logs collector configured in YAML; OutSystems Cloud and ODC are otlp. The source holds no credential: the collector's are in its YAML.

application_name.description: The OutSystems Application_Name: the service.name of the application's logs and the application label of its derived metrics. Matched exactly, case included. Within an environment, one name belongs to one application. Spaces only as ASCII spaces between other characters, and no control or format characters, so that two names that look alike are alike.
